Name: Mountain Top Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b]features[/b]
* replaces [b]standard [/b]farm by default (configurable)
* works in multiplayer (select [b]separate [/b]cabins at the start)
* working lights and signposts
* slightly bigger farm cave with minecart link (can be turned off)
* compatible with eemie's recolour and starblue valley


[b]installation
[/b]1. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]
2. download this mod and extract the folder to Stardew Valley/Mods
3. run the game with SMAPI


[b]configuration[/b]
> run the game once with mod installed to generate/refresh config file

"[u]MapToReplace[/u]": "Standard", "Forest", "Riverland", "Hilltop", or "Wilderness"
"[u]FarmCaveEnabled[/u]": "true" or "false"
